QuestInfo.name: Kerning City Investigation: Alex
QuestInfo.0: Come to think of it, there is a person you know in #b#m103000000##k. Go ask #b#p1052000##k in #m100000000# if he knows anything about a thief.
QuestInfo.1: #p1052000# says that he will answer anything for you if you give him some news about #m100000000#. News about #m100000000#, what could you tell him about? Talk to #p1052000#.
QuestInfo.2: #p1052000# doesn't seem to know anything about the thief. However, #p1052000# did tell you about the person you should question next.

0.0: Hey, Evan, how are ya? Long time no see. What are you doing here? Have you run away from home, too? Or are you on an adventure?\r\n#b#L0#(You tell him about becoming a Guard.)#l\n#k
0.1: Wow, a Guard? That's pretty cool. You used to be so clumsy, so I'm kind of shocked. But what brings you to #m103000000#?\r\n#b#L0#(You tell him about #p1061005#'s stolen herb.)#l\n#k
0.2: So you're looking for the herb thief in #m103000000#? Well, can I help? Actually, if you can give me some news about #b#m100000000##k, I'll tell you about someone who might know what's going on.

yes.0: News about #m100000000#... What should I ask you about first. It's been so long. Give me a second. Let me think.

no.0: You don't want to? And I was going to help you since you are an old friend.

1.0:
What should I ask first? Yeah okay, this is good. Is there anyone that has left #m100000000#? Tell me, which of these people are no longer in Henesys?
#b#L0#Casey#l
#L1#Morrow#l
#L2#Denma the Owner#l
#L3#Chief Stan#l
#k
1.1:
Oh really... Mr. Morrow? I guess he got tired. How about that one girl? What was her name? The girl who never came out of her house because she was so sick. The blond.
#b#L0#Pia#l
#L1#Rina#l
#L2#Maya#l
#L3#Vicious#l
#k
1.2:
How about #p1012109#? Is he always still reading? His eyes are probably bad by now. Does #p1012109# wear glasses now? What type of clothes does he wear? He's always had a horrible sense of fashion.
#b#L0#Dinosaur-shaped clothes#l
#L1#Apron with frills on the front#l
#L2#Doctor's gown#l
#L3#Glasses and a green robe#l

1.3:
Oh, did the festival start in #m100000000#? I've been hearing a lot about it. Who was it that's running it? 
#L0##bMrs. Ming Ming#l
#L1#Super Sucker#l
#L2#Bruce#l
#L3#Big Headward#l

1.4: So it still hasn't happened, huh? I guess she is still a perfectionist. How big does she want this festival to be? Hmm... What else should I ask you...\r\n#b#L0#Aren't you going to ask about Chief Stan?#l\n#k
1.5: What? Why should I ask about him? I'm not interested. Hmmpf. But um, does he still use the same cane? \r\n#b#L0#Yeah.#l\n#k
1.6: Sheesh, that miser. I told him so many times to get a new cane... Not that I really care or anything! Haha. Hehe... Um, so yeah... You were looking for a thief in #m103000000# right?

yes.0: Try talking to #b#p1052002##k down there. He know about all the back alley transactions. If the herb or whatever was being traded, he would know.

0.0: Casey, the Mini Game Master, left town? That's strange... I actually know someone who went to Henesys to play Mini Games. Are you mistaken?
0.2: Denma the Owner's plastic surgery skills are famous even in Kerning City. Are you sure you haven't gotten him mixed up with someone else?
0.3: There's no way HE would have left Henesys... Are you trying to test me?

1.0: No, no. Not Pia. Pia is the strange kid who always wears a stuffed animal costume. Not him, but the really sick one... What was her name?
1.1: Yeah, Rina is blond, but not her. The girl who is closer to our age.
1.3: Vicous is a guy...! I'm talking about a girl!

2.0: No way, Jay isn't walking around dressed up just like Pia now, right?! Please tell me it's not true!
2.1: Jay's taste has gotten that bad?
2.2: What? Are you saying that Jay's a doctor now or something? No way. Do you know how scared Jay is of blood. He faints at the sight of a needle.

3.1: Isn't Ms. Tan the Dermatologist? If she held the festival, it would be a Brazilian Samba Festival rather than a Henesys Festival. Theirs is no way they would have allowed that!
3.2: If Bruce is in charge, it's going to be Golems all the way down. That guy needs a new hobby.
3.3: Big Headward? Who's that? Whoever he is, I can only imagine the size of his head...
